Zone name: I can't give you one. Capacity Manager groups by availability-zone ID (use1-az6), not by zone name. AWS maps zone names such as us-east-1a to zone IDs independently for each account, so the name for use1-az6 differs from account to account, and this payer-level result spans reservations in many accounts. Nothing in the result says which name use1-az6 has in the account your Terraform runs in. Run `aws ec2 describe-availability-zones --region us-east-1` in that account (it lists ZoneName next to ZoneId), or switch your modules to zone IDs.
